part: Corno II / Horn II in F
reviewer_range: physical PDF page 11, Movement I systems 1–7 only; exclude all material below the printed II Adagio divider
pitch_convention: Written pitch read in printed treble/G clef; scientific octave C4=middle C. F horn concert pitch is a perfect fifth below written pitch. Japanese fixed-do solfege includes octave numbers.
transposition: Horn in F: concert pitch is written pitch transposed down a perfect fifth. Diatonic spelling is preserved and the target accidental is recomputed to preserve the interval.

clef_review.systems_1_to_7: Each printed clef glyph was inspected from the source page at high resolution and reads as treble G. No 8-below marker is visible.

key_signature_observation.observation: The first system is a continuation on printed part page 3. A one-flat glyph at the page-start/continuation edge cannot be ruled in or out from this scan; no signature is clearly repeated at later system starts. No key-signature alteration has been applied.
key_signature_observation.primary_reading: Unmarked notes use natural spelling provisionally unless a local accidental is visible.
key_signature_observation.alternative: If one flat is confirmed from the preceding page, each unmarked B on this page becomes B-flat; alternatives are recorded on the affected notes.

measure_mapping: Audiveris measure 1 is treated as printed measure 275, advancing by one per measure. Sparse printed labels 275, 280, 285, 290, 300, 305, 310, 315 align with source layout; unprinted sequential measure numbers are candidates.
review_method: Rendered physical page 11 at 380 dpi and inspected high-resolution source crops for systems 1–7. Notehead centers and boxes use the 380 dpi coordinate frame. Written diatonic pitches were derived from source notehead centers and local staff lines, independent of MusicXML. Explicit accidental glyphs were checked in the source and stored with coordinates. Audiveris 5.11.0 MusicXML supplied provisional duration candidates only. Material below the II Adagio divider was excluded.
omr_engine: Audiveris 5.11.0; candidate only, source image is authoritative

cue_review.review_note: No instrument-labelled cue passage was confirmed with sufficient confidence in Movement I systems 1–7. The eight source-only heads remain part-staff observations with playback excluded until their rhythm/role is resolved.

unresolved: The first-system page-start key signature remains unresolved. No key signature was applied; all unmarked B pitches include explicit B-natural/B-flat alternatives if one flat is later confirmed.

Eight visible D5 heads have no matching MusicXML note event: seven in system 3 (x=1727, 1794, 1912, 1976, 2092, 2161, 2282 px) and one in system 7 (x=2552 px). Their source coordinates and pitches are retained, durations are null, and playback is excluded pending manual rhythm/role review.
MusicXML duration values for matched heads remain provisional and need a dedicated rhythm pass before playback authority.
No cue-source label could be confirmed within the scoped systems; do not infer a cue source from the OMR omissions.
